title: Nutty Gooey Ethiopian Beef Stew
description: A rich and flavorful Ethiopian-inspired stew featuring tender beef in a nutty and slightly sweet gravy, perfect for a low-carb diet. This dish is slow-cooked to perfection with a blend of aromatic spices and nuts.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add the onion and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the berbere spice mix, cumin, and coriander. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the peanuts and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, and browned beef back to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
